```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="chest_lidded">
  <!-- Dimensions (meters) -->
  <!-- Width X: 0.95 (extends from -0.475 to +0.475) -->
  <!-- Depth Z? no: Depth along Y: 0.36 (front faces -Y; origin at center so Y from -0.18 to +0.18) -->
  <!-- Height Z: 0.60 (origin on floor, so base at Z=0 and top at Z=0.60) -->

  <!-- ===== Materials ===== -->
  <material name="wood_dark">
    <color rgba="0.55 0.35 0.20 1"/>
  </material>
  <material name="wood_medium">
    <color rgba="0.65 0.45 0.25 1"/>
  </material>
  <material name="wood_light">
    <color rgba="0.75 0.58 0.35 1"/>
  </material>

  <!-- =======================
       Link: Chest Base
       ======================= -->
  <link name="base">
    <!-- Mass -->
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.265" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="25.0"/>
      <!-- Approximate cuboid: width 0.95, depth 0.36, height 0.53 (base thickness) -->
      <!-- Ixx = 1/12*m*(y^2+z^2) where y=0.36, z=0.53 -->
      <!-- Iyy = 1/12*m*(x^2+z^2) where x=0.95, z=0.53 -->
      <!-- Izz = 1/12*m*(x^2+y^2) where x=0.95, y=0.36 -->
      <inertia ixx="3.91" iyy="7.01" izz="6.51" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyz="0"/>
    </inertial>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.265" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.95 0.36 0.53"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_medium"/>
    </visual>

    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.265" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.95 0.36 0.53"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- =======================
       Link: Lid
       ======================= -->
  <link name="lid">
    <!-- Lid is a flat plate; thickness 0.03 m -->
    <!-- Hinged along the back edge: back edge at +Y(+0.18), lid spans width in X -->
    <!-- Lid swings up to open, rotating about hinge axis along X (right-left) -->
    <!-- Lid COM centered at Y = +0.18 (hinge line) + t/2 (toward front) if thickness is in Y -->
    <!-- We model lid thickness along Y with size (x=0.95, y=0.03, z=0.60?) -->
    <!-- Real chest: lid thickness negligible; use lid as a plate: x by depth thickness, with negligible height -->
    <!-- We'll model lid as a plate of dimensions: width (0.95) in X, thickness (0.03) in Y, and height (0.06) in Z for collision/visual -->
    <!-- Position: lid bottom edge at Z=0.60 when closed; hinge along back edge at Z=0.60 -->
    <!-- Choose lid plate center at Z=0.60 - 0.03 (half plate thickness in Z), and center at Y=+0.18 - 0.015 (so it overlaps base back edge) -->
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0.165 0.585" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <!-- Approximate mass of a lid plate -->
      <mass value="4.5"/>
      <!-- Approximate cuboid for inertia: x=0.95, y=0.03, z=0.06 -->
      <!-- Ixx = 1/12*m*(y^2+z^2) -->
      <!-- Iyy = 1/12*m*(x^2+z^2) -->
      <!-- Izz = 1/12*m*(x^2+y^2) -->
      <inertia ixx="0.04" iyy="0.18" izz="0.20" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyz="0"/>
    </inertial>

    <visual>
      <!-- Visual plate -->
      <origin xyz="0 0.165 0.585" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.95 0.03 0.06"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </visual>

    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0.165 0.585" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.95 0.03 0.06"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- =======================
       Joint: Lid hinge at back edge
       ======================= -->
  <!-- Joint frame at hinge line: along X axis at back edge (Y=+0.18),
       at top surface Z=0.60. Lid rotates about X axis. -->
  <joint name="lid_hinge" type="revolute">
    <origin xyz="0 0.18 0.60" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <!-- Rotation axis along X -->
    <axis xyz="1 0 0" />
    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="lid"/>
    <!-- Allow opening upward; closed at 0 rad. Limit to 0..pi/2 typical -->
    <limit lower="0.0" upper="1.57079632679" effort="30.0" velocity="2.0"/>
  </joint>
</robot>
```
